notes: The exact mappings below follow the canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador API header. The scenario first resolves and round-trips mandatory standard values while joined, then checks FederateNotExecutionMember for the same valid names and handles after resignation with the connection still open.

requirements.statement: The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getOrderType. The test resolves the mandatory Receive and TimeStamp names while joined, then verifies that exception for both valid names after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getOrderName. The test supplies the valid Receive and TimeStamp values obtained while joined, then verifies that exception for both after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getTransportationTypeHandle. The test resolves the mandatory HLAreliable and HLAbestEffort names while joined, then verifies that exception for both valid names after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getTransportationTypeName. The test supplies valid HLAreliable and HLAbestEffort handles obtained while joined, then verifies that exception for both after resignation while connected.
